title: What is the daily maintenance of Jura?
desc:
Daily Jura Maintenance
It's important to empty the drip tray and waste bins daily to prevent mould buildup. Jura also recommends emptying the water tank between uses to ensure that you are using fresh water each day for your morning cup of coffee.

title: What is the common problem of a Jura coffee machine?
desc:
Common issues with Jura coffee machines include: The machine does not start due to faulty power switches.
Weak or bitter coffee may result from grind size, tamping pressure, or imbalanced temperature. Stagnant water can occur from a stagnant filter or blocked pipes.

title: How do you clean Jura automatic coffee machine?
desc:
JURA automatic coffee machines feature integrated rinsing and cleaning programs that are displayed automatically. When you start a program at the touch of a button, the machine will prompt you to add a cleaning tablet.
During the subsequent automatic cleaning process, water temperatures reach 80 °C.

title: Will Jura coffee taste better after descaling?
desc:
Descaling your Jura coffee maker is crucial for its maintenance. If you neglect to descale regularly, you may encounter problems such as altered flavour and reduced heating efficiency.
By descaling your Jura coffee maker, you eliminate the mineral deposits that build up over time, helping to ensure optimal performance and a better taste in your coffee.

title: What are the top Jura error codes?
desc:
• Error 2 (Coffee Temperature Sensor/Too Cold): It is very common for the machine to experience issues if it is kept in a cold room.
  • Error 5 (Heating Failure): The machine may not reach the required temperature due to severe limescale buildup or a blown thermal fuse.
  • Error 6 (Valve Failure): The ceramic valve is often blocked or malfunctioning, a common issue observed in Z-series machines.
  • Error 8 (Brew Group Failure): The most common serious error indicates that the brew group is jammed, sluggish, or that the encoder may be faulty.
  • Fill System/Open Tap: Indicates a blockage in the water flow.

title: What does error 4 mean on a Jura espresso machine?
desc:
Error 4 – steam thermoblock exceeded maximum temperature
You should visually check if the cable to the thermal sensor is damaged or if the contact pins are corroded. If so, take it to Jura or your supplier.

title: What does Error 2 mean on a Jura coffee machine?
desc: This error message indicates that the coffee Thermoblock is not reaching the necessary temperature to brew coffee.

title: Common Jura Error Codes
desc:
• Jura Error 1, 2, 3, 5: Failure of the temperature sensor (NTC) or thermoblock.
  • Jura Error 4: There is an issue with the steam thermoblock, either due to overheating or a faulty sensor.
  • Jura Error 6: The ceramic valve is either malfunctioning or not initialising properly.
  • Jura Error 8: Brew Group Malfunction (most common): The brew group is either stuck or operating sluggishly.
  • Jura Error 12: The grinder blades are jammed.
  • Jura Error 22: The water filter is not recognised.
